player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Joueur {player_id} na **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Soumetez votrë mouvement sous forme **[macro  micro]** (deux nombres 0-8):
• *macro*  = mini-plateau wapi ozali komona
• *micro* = carré wapi nde libanda ya mini-plateau
Exemple `[7 8]` ➜ poser votrë marque na mini-plateau 7, carré 8, et
forcer adversaire wenu komona na mini-plateau 8 elongo.

Ozali `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Motango ya mbongwana esengeli kozala na lolenge [macro micro] elongo na mitángo 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Indices nionso esengeli kozala kati na 0 mpe 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, molongo to col ezali na kati ya range te.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Na kati ya ndako yango, moto moko azali te.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Esengeli ete mosani yango abeta na etanda ya mike oyo ezali pembeni.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Bapanzi-nsango ya mike basili kozwa yango.

game_action.played: Mokonzi {player_id} akomaki na bolita ya mikolo {macro_idx}, liloba {micro_idx} (lilobi {row}, lokolo {col}). Mokonzi {opponent_id} abimi oyo azali kozwana na {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Mokili {player_id} azwi Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
outcome.draw: Lisano yango ezali na nsuka te!
